description: Final closing Hwang Adjusted Positional ADP for the 2026 season. Historical 2026 sims and outcome catalogs should keep using these numbers. Live FantasyPros scrapes may continue updating site/public/data/adp/fantasypros_adp_*_2026.csv; those files are not the historical source once this snapshot exists.

method.summary: Shift best-ball ADP for RB/WR by (std_stack_rank - half_stack_rank); QB/TE pass through raw best-ball avg ADP.

reconstruct: To rebuild with a later Hwang ADP method, keep these FantasyPros CSVs and run: python3 scripts/compute_hwang_scoring_adp.py 2026 --recompute-closed. That refreshes the combined site CSV only; this folder stays as the original closing snapshot unless you freeze again with --force.
